bullets.text: In Ambattur, a young man named Hariprasad died after his motorcycle fell into a rainwater drainage canal, and the office should monitor drainage safety.
A district principal court sentenced a man to double life imprisonment for raping a tribal woman in Pazhaverkadu, and the office should track legal updates.
Public caught a young man who tried to burn a college student by pouring petrol near Periyapalayam in Thiruvallur, and the office should watch safety measures.
The Madras High Court reserved orders on writ petitions challenging the NGT construction ban around Pallikaranai marshland, and the office should watch the verdict.
PMK leader Anbumani Ramadoss released a video on climate change risks regarding Pallikaranai wetland, and the office should review environmental awareness campaigns.
GCC proposed a 200-crore infrastructure upgrade plan for Guindy and Ambattur industrial estates, and the office should monitor project implementation.
Slow 6-lane highway work near Uthukottai caused severe traffic congestion, and the office should coordinate with transport authorities to ease traffic.
Ponneri municipality cut off water supply to homes and shops that did not pay taxes, and the office should review municipal collection drives.
Five IndiaAI cloud service providers are ineligible for a new compute tender because they lack local data centres, and the office should watch cloud policies.
Redington is growing via AI exposure and diversifying into smart glasses and robots, and the office should track hardware and AI sector expansion in Chennai.
Nearly 1,800 Tamil books in Coimbatore's library were flagged for suspected AI-generated content and errors, and the office should monitor digital content quality.
BJP leader L. Murugan criticized the administration during a visit to Thiruvallur, and the office should watch political developments and opposition statements.
Raptee HV opened a new electric bike experience centre on OMR Road in Perungudi inaugurated via video conference, and the office should track EV investments.
